$schema: Canonical label set for refluster/ai-native-article. See docs/issue-labeling.md for taxonomy and decision flow. Reconciled to GitHub by scripts/sync-labels.mjs.

labels.name: project:article
labels.description: Article pipeline (kohuehara.xyz blog). Mandatory project axis.

labels.name: project:workforce
labels.description: Workforce subsystem (workforce.kohuehara.xyz). Mandatory project axis.

labels.name: layer:L0
labels.description: Touches an L0 invariant (C-1..C-4 or W-1..W-5). Operator-only amendments.

labels.name: layer:L1
labels.description: Touches an L1 doc (governance/architecture/data-model/naming/azure-budget/DESIGN/GROWTH/PIPELINE).

labels.name: layer:L2
labels.description: Touches a mechanical guard (R-1..R-9 / R-N1..R-N8), runtime throw, lint, or CI check.

labels.name: layer:L3
labels.description: Operational: runbook, skill SKILL.md, post-deploy verification, scripts/.

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Something is broken. Live invariant violation, regression, or incident follow-up.

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: New capability, endpoint, skill, or page.

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: Refactor, dependency bump, cleanup, naming change, doc reorg.

labels.name: type:tracker
labels.description: Index issue that decomposes into sub-issues (epic tracker, RFC rollout).

labels.name: type:ops
labels.description: Operational: post-deploy verification, observation window, Status flip.

labels.name: area:gas
labels.description: Touches gas/src/Code.gs or the Apps Script deployment.

labels.name: area:spa
labels.description: Touches the React SPA (src/, apps/workforce/src/, template/).

labels.name: area:backend
labels.description: Touches workforce Lambdas, DDB, S3, or infra/sam/.

labels.name: area:content
labels.description: Article content quality, Notion DB schema, generated prose.

labels.name: area:infra
labels.description: CI workflows, deploy keys, environment config, CloudWatch.

labels.name: area:docs
labels.description: Documentation: governance, runbooks, design notes, READMEs.

labels.name: area:design-tokens
labels.description: tailwind.config.ts, design-token lint, visual primitives.

labels.name: epic-010
labels.description: Epic-010 — Project as trust boundary (workforce).

labels.name: epic-011
labels.description: Epic-011 — Workforce activity feed (LinkedIn-style).

labels.name: epic-012
labels.description: Epic-012 — Agent experience: recall, long-term memory, clean activity record (workforce).

labels.name: epic-013
labels.description: Epic-013 — Talent messaging: operator↔talent thread store (workforce).

labels.name: epic-014
labels.description: Epic-014 — Global nav search: talent + skills typeahead (workforce).

labels.name: role:engineering
labels.description: Driven by an engineering persona.

labels.name: role:architecture
labels.description: Driven by an architecture persona.

labels.name: role:product
labels.description: Driven by a product persona.

labels.name: role:design
labels.description: Driven by a design persona.

labels.name: insights
labels.description: Auto-generated by the weekly content-insights loop (reader-engagement → editorial roadmap). One open issue at a time.

labels.name: wf:ready
labels.description: Pickup-ready: dependencies clear, body complete.

labels.name: wf:in-progress
labels.description: Active work in flight. Has an assignee or open PR.

labels.name: wf:blocked
labels.description: Blocked on an external dep or another issue. Blocker named in body.

labels.name: priority:p0
labels.description: Live invariant violation in production (C-1/W-1/etc.). Drop everything.

labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: Blocks an in-flight epic or the live site for non-invariant reasons.
